model_annotations.Bulgarian: Фигурата илюстрира промените в редица стойности на спарситетен отношение (sparsity ratio) преди и след прилагането на врата (gate) във визуално представена форма. По оста X се вижда последователност от стойности, обозначени като индекси, които започват от 0 и завършват при стойност около 10, с равномерно разпределени етикети на всеки пет индекса. Оста Y е обозначена като "sparsity ratio" и използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до 1, с етикети на всеки 0.2. В графиката са представени три линии: първата, означена като "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.83", е оранжева пунктирана линия, която започва при стойност около 0.85 и показва спад до около 0.44, след което варира със слаби вълновидни колебания; втората, "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33", е зелена пунктирана линия, започваща при около 0.85 и падаща до около 0.33, като продължава да намалява по-бързо и по-бавно, със слаби вълновидни колебания; третата, "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", е синя пунктирана линия, започваща при около 0.85 и падаща до около 0.44, след което се стабилизира на ниво около 0.44.
model_annotations.Chinese: The graph displays the sparsity ratio over time for three different conditions: "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.85," "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," and "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44." The x-axis represents time, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 100, marked at intervals of 20. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, marked at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line, representing the sparsity ratio before gate, starts at a value of approximately 0.85 and remains relatively flat, with minor fluctuations, ending at approximately 0.83. The green dashed line, representing the sparsity ratio after average gate, starts at a value of approximately 0.85 and shows a sharp decrease, reaching a value of approximately 0.33 by the end of the x-axis range. The orange dotted line, representing the sparsity ratio after gate, starts at a value of approximately 0.85 and also shows a sharp decrease, reaching a value of approximately 0.44 by the end of the x-axis range, with some fluctuations in the middle of the range.
model_annotations.English: The line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio over a sequence of steps, comparing three different conditions: the sparsity ratio before the gate, and the sparsity ratio after the gate using either an average gate or a standard gate. The x-axis, labeled "Step," ranges from 0 to 1000 in increments of 200, representing the progression of the process. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot includes three distinct lines: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate, which starts at a value of approximately 0.0 and remains relatively flat, fluctuating slightly around 0.02; a green dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate, which begins at approximately 0.85 and shows a sharp decline to a value of about 0.33, followed by a period of fluctuation; and an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, which starts at a value of approximately 0.85 and also declines sharply, reaching a value of about 0.44 before fluctuating. The legend indicates that the average sparsity ratio before the gate is 0.85, and after the average gate is 0.33.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den Verlauf der Sparsitätsverhältnisse vor und nach einem Gate-Operation in einem Modell, wobei die x-Achse die Schichten oder Schritte repräsentiert, die von links nach rechts zunehmen, ohne explizite numerische Beschriftung, und die y-Achse die Sparsitätsverhältnisse anzeigt, die von oben nach unten abnehmen. Die y-Achse ist linear skaliert und reicht von etwa 0,85 bis 0,33, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen nicht numerisch angegeben sind. Es werden drei Linien dargestellt: eine gestrichelte blaue Linie, die den Sparsitätsverhältnis vor dem Gate darstellt und bei etwa 0,85 beginnt, stark abfällt und dann bei etwa 0,33 stabilisiert; eine punktierte orange Linie, die das Sparsitätsverhältnis nach dem Durchgang durch ein durchschnittliches Gate zeigt, beginnt bei etwa 0,85, fällt ebenfalls stark ab und stabilisiert sich bei etwa 0,44, wobei sie nach dem Abfall einige Schwankungen aufweist; und eine gestrichelte grüne Linie, die das Sparsitätsverhältnis nach dem Durchgang durch ein durchschnittliches Gate darstellt, beginnt bei etwa 0,85, fällt steil ab und stabilisiert sich bei etwa 0,33, wobei sie nach dem Abfall ebenfalls einige Schwankungen aufweist. Die Linien zeigen, dass das Sparsitätsverhältnis nach dem Gate-Operation in beiden Fällen sinkt, wobei die grüne Linie einen geringeren Wert erreicht als die orange Linie.
